recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a person's midriff wearing light-wash denim jeans, adorned with heavy, ornate gold and jewel-toned jewelry. A central graphic burst overlay contains stylized typography and a crown motif.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between casual denim and opulent jewelry
Symmetry of hands framing the central graphic element
Warm skin tones against cool blue denim and light blue graphic burst
Vertical alignment of long beaded necklaces leading to the focal point
coreInvariants: Multiple gold rings with large gemstones
Central starburst graphic with jagged edges
Ornate crown icon above the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up on the torso and hands, filling the frame from waist to lower chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central light-blue starburst graphic containing the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central graphic, follow the necklaces upward, then move down to the hands and rings, finally resting on the denim texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with skin, fabric, and jewelry.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and light-wash blue denim provide the primary canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep reds, purples, and gold from the jewelry provide rich contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright light-blue starburst and black typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the jewels; high value (brightness) in the denim and skin.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a condensed, high-contrast serif with sharp, elongated terminals.
Secondary text follows a circular path around the bottom of the starburst.
Metadata text at the bottom is a wide, geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The primary text is arched and features a drop shadow to create depth against the graphic burst.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a wide geometric sans-serif for technical metadata.

avoid: Modern minimalist sans-serif for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs similar to the display text.
Wide, geometric structure for the bottom metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up photograph of a person's midriff wearing light-blue denim jeans. The person's hands are placed on their hips, wearing many large gold rings with colorful gemstones. Two long, ornate necklaces with gold beads and red/purple jewels hang down the center. The lighting is warm and slightly grainy, reminiscent of late 80s film photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a jagged, light-blue starburst graphic in the center. Add a black ornate crown icon at the top of the burst. Place the primary title in a black, arched, high-contrast serif font with a gold outline across the burst. Add secondary text following a circular path below the title. Place a wide, white sans-serif metadata line at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the denim texture visible and realistic?
Does the starburst have sharp, irregular points?
Is the primary text arched correctly?
Are the jewelry tones rich and saturated?

mustRedesign: Unique jewelry designs that are trademarked
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic skin texture and lighting
Ensure the starburst does not obscure too much jewelry detail
Verify the bottom text is legible against the denim
Confirm the arched text follows the curve of the starburst
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-fashion photography of textured fabric and ornate accessories with 80s-style jagged graphic overlays and high-contrast serif typography.
